table.retrieve:
select  	
	item.name,
	itemaliasname=item.customicode,
	ItemPacking.name, 
	quotationheader.quotationcode,
	quotationheader.custcode,
	quotationheader.custrefno,
	quotationheader.headerno,
	usercode=quotationheader.salesmancode,
	quotationheader.remarks,
	invdiscperc=quotationheader.discperc,
	quotationheader.date,
	LooseQty=sd.looseqty,
	sd.bonusqty,
	sd.SalePrice, 
	sd.Itemflatdisc,
	sd.discperc,
	sd.gstperc,
	sd.unitsalestax,
	customeraliasname=dbo.accounts.aliasname,	
	dbo.accounts.name
From   
	(Select icode,quotationcode,looseqty=qty,bonusqty,saleprice,itemflatdisc,discperc,gstperc,unitsalestax From quotationdetail Where icode = :ar_icode) sd 
       Inner Loop join quotationheader On sd.quotationcode = quotationheader.quotationcode 
       Inner Join Accounts On quotationheader.CustCode = Accounts.Acccode
       Inner Join Item On SD.Icode = Item.Icode 
       Left  Outer Join ItemPacking On Item.packcode = ItemPacking.PackCode
